synopsis.synopsisDesc:
CIARD supports teams that build open, AI-ready research data infrastructure: pipelines that clean, document and publish scientific datasets with machine-readable metadata. Proposals are reviewed on the two NSF merit review criteria, Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts, plus the solicitation-specific criterion of data sustainability after the award period.

Small businesses may apply as lead or as subawardees.
